title: 第428章 白夜大会二第427章 白夜大会一
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
“够了！”
一声怒喝从大殿外传来，下一秒，从大殿外走入两道身影，众人看到为首之人，赶忙放下手中茶杯，正了正衣服，站起身来。
“易水华，你给我等着。”许风瞪着易水华小声说道。
“那小妮子说什么你都信，让你死你死不死。”易水华小声说道。
二人互相瞪了一眼，一抬头，却看到哲不知何时已经悄无声息的站在二人面前，一瞬间，一股冷意从二人后脖升起，那一刻，二人只感觉站在自己面前的不是人，而是从地狱而来的阎罗。
虽然二人并不像谢广鹏和雅曼一样，和哲比较熟络，但是哲在影中那黑无常的名号二人却是早有耳闻，二人大战之后还好奇者突如其来的人到底是谁，稍微一打听，才知道他竟然就是大名鼎鼎的哲。（二百多章没写过哲了，只怕是已经有人忘了哲那黑无常的名号。）
万幸，下一秒，哲便带着苏少卿离开二人面前，直直走上台阶，随后，在众人惊讶的目光中，哲竟然泰然自若的直接坐在了长渊宗宗主之位上。
谢广鹏和秦玉霜看到这一幕，回头又看到众人满是疑惑的看着自己，二人对视一眼，微微点了点头。
对于哲之前的那个要求，谢广鹏早就和几位长老共同商讨过了。（详情见第358章）
“诸位，这位，便是我长渊宗新继位的宗主，哲。”谢广鹏站出来说道。
众人闻言，瞬间震惊，连带着哲身后的苏少卿都瞬间愣在原地。
“怎么回事，他不是阴阳门张三疯的弟子吗，怎么会是长渊宗的宗主。”
…………
几位宗主相互传音道。
被哲硬拉在宗主位置后面的苏少卿一脸震惊的看着哲。
“处理完事情送你一份大礼。”哲面无表情，连头也没回的小声说道。
台下众人相互都在传音，哲悄悄的敲了敲椅子，众人瞬间不敢在说话，都安静的看着哲。
“我听说，你们在商讨怎么分割黑山教啊。”哲轻声说道。
“是，宗主，具体怎么分配，我们还在商量。”谢广鹏面向哲说道。
“我给出一个方案，你们看看行不行。”哲戏谑的看了看众人，说道：“按照功劳分配，功劳最大者，全拿。”

此话一出，顿时惊呆了在场众人，连带着苏少卿和谢广鹏都被哲这番言论震惊，而哲的这一句话，也瞬间激起众怒。
易水华的许风听到哲的话，对于哲的害怕瞬间抛之脑后，愤怒之色顿时显在脸上。
其他人虽然神色看上去还比较正常，但是看样子，也或多或少的带着些许怒气，除了雅曼，她的眼神中满是期待，似乎是想到了之前哲说过的某些话。
整座长渊大殿，都因哲那句轻飘飘的“功劳最大者，全拿”，而瞬间陷入一种诡异的气氛。
方才争执不休、暗流涌动的资源博弈，在此刻显得无比可笑。
在他们看来，全域宗门浴血拼杀换来的胜果，由长渊宗一家独吞，这根本不是分配，而是赤裸裸的抢劫。
“你什么意思，这一次剿灭黑山教，每个宗门都或多或少的出了力，凭什么你长渊宗全拿。”许风眉头皱起怒道。
content_en:
"Enough!"
An angry shout came from outside the hall, and the next second, two figures walked in from outside the hall. When everyone saw the leader, they quickly put down their teacups, straightened their clothes, and stood up.
"Yi Shuihua, just wait for me." Xu Feng glared at Yi Shuihua and whispered.
"Then you believe whatever Xiao Nizi says, and you will die as long as you die." Yi Shuihua said in a low voice.
The two glared at each other, and when they raised their heads, they saw Zhe standing silently in front of them. For a moment, a cold feeling rose from the backs of their necks. At that moment, they felt that the person standing in front of them was not a human being, but Yama from hell.
Although the two of them were not as familiar with Zhe as Xie Guangpeng and Yaman were, they had already heard of Zhe's black and impermanent name in the film. After the battle between the two, they were still curious about who the sudden man was. After a little inquiry, they found out that he was actually the famous Zhe. (Zhe has not been written about in more than two hundred chapters. I am afraid that some people have forgotten Zhe’s black and impermanent name.)
Fortunately, in the next second, Zhe led Su Shaoqing away from the two of them and walked straight up the steps. Then, in the surprised eyes of everyone, Zhe calmly sat directly on the seat of the leader of the Changyuan Sect.
When Xie Guangpeng and Qin Yushuang saw this scene, they turned around and saw everyone looking at them with confusion. They looked at each other and nodded slightly.
Xie Guangpeng had already discussed Zhe's previous request with several elders. (See Chapter 358 for details)
"Everyone, this is the newly succeeded leader of our Changyuan Sect, Zhe." Xie Guangpeng stood up and said.
Everyone was shocked when they heard this, and even Su Shaoqing, who was behind Zhe, was stunned on the spot.
"What's going on? Isn't he a disciple of Zhang Sanfeng of the Yin-Yang Sect? How can he be the leader of the Changyuan Sect?"
…………
Several sect leaders communicated to each other.
Su Shaoqing, who was pulled behind the sect leader's position by Zhe, looked at Zhe in shock.
"I'll give you a big gift after I take care of the matter." Zhe whispered without any expression on his face, without even looking back.
Everyone in the audience was communicating with each other. Zhe knocked on the chair quietly. For a moment, everyone did not dare to speak and looked at Zhe quietly.
"I heard that you are discussing how to divide the Black Mountain Sect." Zhe said softly.
"Yes, Sect Master, we are still discussing the specific distribution." Xie Guangpeng said to Zhe.
"I'll give you a plan, let's see if it works." Zhe looked at everyone jokingly and said, "According to the credit, the one with the greatest credit will get it all."
As soon as these words came out, everyone present was stunned. Even Su Shaoqing and Xie Guangpeng were shocked by Zhe's remarks, and Zhe's words instantly aroused public anger.
When Yi Shuihua's Xu Feng heard Zhe's words, his fear of Zhe was instantly forgotten, and anger suddenly appeared on his face.
Although the others looked relatively normal, they looked more or less angry, except for Yaman, whose eyes were full of expectation, as if she had thought of something Zhe had said before.
The entire Changyuan Hall was instantly plunged into a strange atmosphere because of Zhe's fluttering words, "The one with the greatest merit will take it all."
The resource game that was full of arguments and undercurrents just now seems extremely ridiculous at this moment.
In their view, the Changyuan Sect's family would monopolize the fruits of victory gained through bloody battles among the sects across the region. This was not a distribution at all, but a naked robbery.
"What do you mean? Every sect contributed more or less to the annihilation of the Black Mountain Sect this time. Why should you, the Changyuan Sect, take all of them?" Xu Feng frowned and said angrily.
